command:
set -euo pipefail
BASE=d1d7b9ec21d2d8e4bcb293559c5133013455c882
git fetch origin mvp/environment-controller agent-control
git reset --hard origin/mvp/environment-controller
git clean -fd
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE"
git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/20260902-stage27c-sd-power-gate-v1.py | python3
.venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --files src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.h src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.cpp || true
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.h src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.cpp
git diff --check
grep -q 'GROWBOX_SD_POWER_GPIO=42' scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh
grep -q 'SD power enabled on GPIO%d' src/climate/storage/Stage27SdDataLogger.cpp
